_about: Per-hunter animation tuning laid over each hunter's own baked clips (assets/hunters/anim/<id>.json, shaped by the original's motion.py personality profiles). Read by render/anim/profile.rs. `default` is the identity (today's look); a row under `hunters` changes only the keys it names. Keys: walk_speed / chase_speed (playback speed of the walk / chase+sprint clips on top of the stride match, 1 = legs match the ground), stride / arm_swing (how far legs / arms swing from rest while a gait clip plays), lean_deg / chase_lean_deg (extra forward torso lean walking / chasing), crouch / chase_crouch (0..1 knee bend with the hips lowered so the feet stay down; the chase one is extra while chasing), idle_sway (how much the idle clip moves), head_roll_deg (head tilt). `states` are mechanic animations switched on by name from render/anim/profile.rs mechanic_of: a `clip` of the hunter's rig (skipped when the rig lacks it), `speed`, `blend`, and/or a `pose` of bone -> [x, y, z] degrees laid over the pose and eased by `blend_in` / `blend_out`. A state in a hunter's row replaces the global one of its name, null removes it. The rows below are a first pass to tune by eye (docs/HUNTER_ANIMATIONS.md).
